findings.title: RemControl: AI Built the Overlays. Victims Lose their PINs
findings.summary_md: Original researcher disclosure by Group-IB reverse engineer Bruno Bijelic, timestamped Wed, 23 Sep 2026 07:26:04 GMT in the Group-IB blog feed, about five hours before this story's first event. It documents RemControl as a previously undocumented Android banking trojan run as a Malware-as-a-Service platform, tracked to operator UNKK, with first VirusTotal samples on July 19, 2026 and C2 domain bnbnhura[.]top registered May 12, 2026. The dropper requests BIND_VPN_SERVICE and routes com.android.vending into a null tunnel to suppress Play Protect real-time checks, then signs each payload with a fresh certificate under subject CN=Android Debug, O=Android, C=US. It confirms more than 30 phishing overlay targets across Italy, France, Spain, Poland, Portugal, Canada and GCC member states, and assesses a possible link to the Medusa UNKN affiliate botnet.

findings.title: Medusa Reborn: A New Compact Variant Discovered
findings.summary_md: Cleafy Labs report published June 20, 2024 documenting the Medusa UNKN botnet, which targeted European users with campaigns focused on Italy and France, was installed via droppers downloaded from untrusted sources, and resolved its C2 address through social media dead-drops including Telegram. Group-IB's RemControl report cites this work: droppers sharing the instal*tvtap*.apk naming convention carried Medusa UNKN payloads until July 2026, then switched to RemControl, and the UNKN tag differs by one letter from RemControl's UNKK affiliate tag. This is the earliest reporting on the distribution channel RemControl now rides on.
